blind.description: A classic fine wooden armchair. It features four legs (turned front legs with square foot bases and curved splayed rear legs), a square-shaped upholstered seat with a green leather or vinyl cushion bordered by brass upholstery studs/tacks, two curved wooden armrests, and an ornate carved wooden backrest with a decorative central splat and curved top rail. The woodwork has a smooth polished medium-brown wood finish. All geometry is solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled with no detached, melted, or missing elements.
blind.from_above: From directly above, the seat cushion appears as a rounded square of dark green, flanked by brown wooden armrests curving inward at the front, and backed by the curved wooden crest rail and back splat.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 3 feet / 0.9–1.0 m tall at the backrest, and around 2 feet wide).
